title: Our History
lineage: Retrospective developer/manufacturer history. It does not establish sale invoices, worldwide first dates, or which 1891 plant supplied each later artifact.

passages.note: Identifies Hall electrolysis, company operations in New Kensington in 1891, market entry with aluminum teakettles in 1895, and Pittsburgh Reduction aluminum cast into the 1903 Wright Flyer engine block and crankcase.
